questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning relating to the air and space?
explanation: Aerospace is correct - A-E-R-O-S-P-A-C-E. Aerospace combines aero meaning air and space meaning outer space.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a person who enforces the law?
explanation: Lawmaker is correct - L-A-W-M-A-K-E-R. A lawmaker is a person who makes laws especially a legislator.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a type of computer storage?
explanation: Database is correct - D-A-T-A-B-A-S-E. A database is a structured collection of data stored electronically.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a place where things are produced?
explanation: Workplace is correct - W-O-R-K-P-L-A-C-E. Workplace combines work and place meaning the location where one works.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a system for measuring time?
explanation: Timeframe is correct - T-I-M-E-F-R-A-M-E. A timeframe is a period of time within which something must be done.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a person in charge of security?
explanation: Watchdog is correct - W-A-T-C-H-D-O-G. A watchdog is a person or group that monitors and exposes wrongdoing.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a type of electronic message?
explanation: Email is correct - E-M-A-I-L. Email is short for electronic mail. Also written as e-mail.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a standard or measure?
explanation: Benchmark is correct - B-E-N-C-H-M-A-R-K. A benchmark is a standard against which others can be measured.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning the main subject of discussion?
explanation: Mainstream is correct - M-A-I-N-S-T-R-E-A-M. Mainstream refers to the prevalent current of thought or activity.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning activity using the internet?
explanation: Online is correct - O-N-L-I-N-E. Online means connected to or accessed via the internet.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a person who oversees workers?
explanation: Supervisor is correct - S-U-P-E-R-V-I-S-O-R. A supervisor is a person who oversees others.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a list of priorities?
explanation: Checklist is correct - C-H-E-C-K-L-I-S-T. A checklist is a list of items to be completed or verified.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a large group of people?
explanation: Multitude is correct - M-U-L-T-I-T-U-D-E. Multitude means a large number of people or things.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a place near the sea?
explanation: Waterfront is correct - W-A-T-E-R-F-R-O-N-T. Waterfront means the area along the edge of a body of water.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a general view or overview?
explanation: Overview is correct - O-V-E-R-V-I-E-W. An overview is a general summary or survey of a subject.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning relating to the whole world?
explanation: Worldwide is correct - W-O-R-L-D-W-I-D-E. Worldwide means extending throughout the entire world.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a gathering of people for discussion?
explanation: Roundtable is correct - R-O-U-N-D-T-A-B-L-E. A roundtable is a meeting in which all participants have equal standing.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a system of laws?
explanation: Framework is correct - F-R-A-M-E-W-O-R-K. A framework is a system of rules or ideas used as a guide.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning the way something develops?
explanation: Pathway is correct - P-A-T-H-W-A-Y. A pathway is a route or course of action.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a formal public statement?
explanation: Newsworthy is correct - N-E-W-S-W-O-R-T-H-Y. Newsworthy means interesting enough to be reported as news.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a person who competes at a high level?
explanation: Frontrunner is correct - F-R-O-N-T-R-U-N-N-E-R. Double N. A frontrunner is the candidate most likely to succeed.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning not connected to the internet?
explanation: Offline is correct - O-F-F-L-I-N-E. Double F. Offline means not connected to a computer network.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning the collection of information?
explanation: Dataset is correct - D-A-T-A-S-E-T. A dataset is a collection of related data items used in analysis.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a careful plan?
explanation: Blueprint is correct - B-L-U-E-P-R-I-N-T. A blueprint is a detailed plan or template for achieving something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning existing since the beginning?
explanation: Longstanding is correct - L-O-N-G-S-T-A-N-D-I-N-G. Longstanding means having existed for a long time.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning an unexpected event?
explanation: Breakthrough is correct - B-R-E-A-K-T-H-R-O-U-G-H. A breakthrough is a sudden important development or discovery.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a broad view of events?
explanation: Outlook is correct - O-U-T-L-O-O-K. Outlook means a person view of life or a general attitude.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning continuing without interruption?
explanation: Nonstop is correct - N-O-N-S-T-O-P. Nonstop means continuing without interruption or pause.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a type of creative thinking?
explanation: Brainstorm is correct - B-R-A-I-N-S-T-O-R-M. To brainstorm means to produce creative ideas spontaneously as a group.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning outside normal working hours?
explanation: Overtime is correct - O-V-E-R-T-I-M-E. Overtime means time worked beyond normal working hours.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a very large city?
explanation: Metropolis is correct - M-E-T-R-O-P-O-L-I-S. Metropolis means a very large and important city.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning something that covers a wide area?
explanation: Widespread is correct - W-I-D-E-S-P-R-E-A-D. Widespread means found or distributed over a large area.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a structure built to cross water?
explanation: Overpass is correct - O-V-E-R-P-A-S-S. Double S. An overpass is a bridge that carries one road over another.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning someone who speaks many languages?
explanation: Polyglot is correct - P-O-L-Y-G-L-O-T. Polyglot combines poly meaning many and glot meaning tongue or language.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning having more than one purpose?
explanation: Multipurpose is correct - M-U-L-T-I-P-U-R-P-O-S-E. Multipurpose means having several uses.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a method of digital communication?
explanation: Broadband is correct - B-R-O-A-D-B-A-N-D. Broadband is a type of high-speed internet connection.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning easy to move around?
explanation: Portable is correct - P-O-R-T-A-B-L-E. Portable means able to be easily carried or moved.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a pattern of activity?
explanation: Workflow is correct - W-O-R-K-F-L-O-W. Workflow means the sequence of processes through which work passes.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a brief summary?
explanation: Snapshot is correct - S-N-A-P-S-H-O-T. A snapshot is a brief look at a situation or a photograph taken quickly.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning relating to two countries?
explanation: Bilateral is correct - B-I-L-A-T-E-R-A-L. Bilateral means involving two parties. From Latin bi meaning two and lateralis meaning side.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a person who delivers goods?
explanation: Courier is correct - C-O-U-R-I-E-R. A courier is a person employed to deliver messages or packages.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a record kept by hand?
explanation: Logbook is correct - L-O-G-B-O-O-K. A logbook is an official record of events or activities.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a person not trained professionally?
explanation: Layperson is correct - L-A-Y-P-E-R-S-O-N. A layperson is someone who is not an expert in a particular field.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning the time just before sleep?
explanation: Bedtime is correct - B-E-D-T-I-M-E. Bedtime means the usual time for going to sleep.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning relating to an agreed standard?
explanation: Protocol is correct - P-R-O-T-O-C-O-L. Protocol means the official procedure or set of rules governing behaviour.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning related to two languages?
explanation: Bilingual is correct - B-I-L-I-N-G-U-A-L. Bilingual means able to speak two languages fluently.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning extremely fast?
explanation: Supersonic is correct - S-U-P-E-R-S-O-N-I-C. Supersonic means faster than the speed of sound.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a self-running computer program?
explanation: Software is correct - S-O-F-T-W-A-R-E. Software means the programs and other operating systems used by a computer.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning the rate at which something happens?
explanation: Throughput is correct - T-H-R-O-U-G-H-P-U-T. Throughput is the amount of material processed in a given period of time.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the compound word meaning a place protected from danger?
explanation: Safeguard is correct - S-A-F-E-G-U-A-R-D. A safeguard is a measure taken to protect against harm.
